name: ScrapingBee CLI
tagline: Scrape pages, search the web, crawl sites and batch hundreds of URLs with the ScrapingBee CLI
description: Teaches Cline when and how to use the ScrapingBee CLI: fetch any web page as markdown, text, HTML or a screenshot (JavaScript rendering, CAPTCHAs and anti-bot blocking handled), run Google, Amazon, Walmart and YouTube searches that return JSON, extract fields in plain English, batch hundreds of URLs from a file or CSV, crawl a whole site with URL filters, write results to disk, and keep credit spend low. Needs `scrapingbee-cli` installed (`uv tool install scrapingbee-cli` or `pip install scrapingbee-cli`) and a ScrapingBee API key.
